mission-board.lede: Almost every live thread is one step short of contact with the outside world: the writing, the packaging and the decisions are done, and the send, the publish or the logged result is not. The board is heavy with finished documents and light on evidence that any of them worked.
mission-board.next_move: Pick the thread closest to a real buyer or a live page and force that one step through this week.
mission-board.caveats: This board sees what was written, finalized and committed. It cannot see what was sent, published, replied to or paid — so a thread reading ready may be ready on the strength of a document alone. Deliverable scores here are self-assessed at finalize time, not outcomes.
mission-board.operator_read: The system is producing well and shipping nothing outward — the bottleneck is contact, not craft.

linkedin.lede: The campaign machinery is written — cadence, follow-up, delivery protocol, and a campaign file that keeps getting touched. What the records do not show is a single send or a logged reply.
linkedin.next_move: Send the offer to real named prospects and log what comes back, before writing any more campaign scaffolding.
linkedin.caveats: Every mission on this thread is closed and the artifacts are recent, but nothing has been finalized through the ledger and no outcome has been recorded — so the thread looks busier than it is proven. Sessions here ran on the other harness, so this sweep sees their titles more than their substance.
linkedin.operator_read: The launch is fully prepared and has not launched.

extract-forge.lede: The build is finished and usable — the skill is verified and there is no functional debt. What remains is a taste verdict that only matters if the work needs a top-tier badge.
extract-forge.next_move: Decide whether A-tier promotion is worth the blind recognition pass, then close this thread either way.

why.0: This is the only thing keeping a finished build filed as unfinished, and it is optional by the thread's own account — a minute of judgment ends it.

extract-forge.caveats: Most of the finalized extractions carry needs-improvement verdicts rather than keep verdicts, so the thread is complete but not demonstrably excellent. The recorded outcomes are amnesty backfills from an old reset, not real-world results, and the thread has been quiet for a while.
extract-forge.operator_read: Done and working — the open item is a badge, not a build.

proof-to-market.lede: The offer layer is documented and marked ready, and the strategy work behind it is closed out. In this window the thread produced thinking about cash validation rather than an attempt at it.
proof-to-market.next_move: Put the ready offer in front of a real buyer and record what they say yes or no to.
proof-to-market.caveats: Nothing was finalized, written or generated against this thread in the window, so ready describes a document rather than a tested offer. The pricing and positioning in it remain unconfirmed until someone pays.
proof-to-market.operator_read: The offer is written and has never met a buyer.

trailer-treatment.lede: The reference pack, continuity manifest and director prompt are finalized. The outcome slot is still sitting on pending, so nothing downstream has been recorded as made from them.
trailer-treatment.next_move: Run the pack through generation and record the result against the pending outcome.
trailer-treatment.caveats: The creative deliverables scored below the keep bar at finalize time, and no outcome has been logged, so this is a well-formed setup with no evidence yet that it produces the intended footage.
trailer-treatment.operator_read: Prep is done; the pack has not been fired.

01-listing-content.lede: The approved reel package is finished and sitting in the clean recording pack, ready to go to the client. The only remaining work is optional tightening of the surrounding stories and b-roll order.
01-listing-content.next_move: Send the approved recording pack to the client and close the thread.

why.0: It is polish on already-approved work, so it is not blocking delivery — leaving it open is what keeps a shipped package looking unshipped.

01-listing-content.caveats: The client work scored below the keep bar at finalize time, no outcome has been recorded, and the thread has gone quiet since approval — the pack may already be with the client without the ledger knowing.

angle-map-listening-engine-v4-1.lede: The listening brief is running and produced both a flagship post and a teardown of unkept promises. The research side of it held up better than the content side.
angle-map-listening-engine-v4-1.next_move: Raise the content take to the keep bar before publishing another brief-driven post.
angle-map-listening-engine-v4-1.caveats: The content deliverable scored well below the research one, which is the signal to watch — the engine is finding material faster than the writing is converting it. No outcome has been logged for either piece.
angle-map-listening-engine-v4-1.operator_read: The listening works; the writing off the back of it is the weak link.

system-audit.lede: The audit deliverables are finalized and a solution card came out of the work, but the recorded outcome says plainly that the findings were never actually read or absorbed. A second outcome closes the thread as a system asset rather than a revenue one.
system-audit.next_move: Read the audit findings and either act on one of them or retire them explicitly.
system-audit.caveats: The thread's own resume line describes client listing work rather than a system audit, so the label and the contents have drifted apart — treat the title with suspicion. The one honest outcome on record is a not-absorbed verdict, which means the work exists but changed nothing.
system-audit.operator_read: Audited, filed, unread — the finding that matters is that nobody read the findings.

first-client-engine.lede: A real offer decision is on record: park the angle-map offer as primary and lock a bounded, paid workflow pilot for small professional-service firms, with scope and exclusions already drawn. Nothing has been sold against it.
first-client-engine.next_move: Take the pilot offer to a first buyer and log whether it sells.
first-client-engine.caveats: The strategy deliverables scored below the keep bar and the outcome is still pending, so this is a well-reasoned bet with no market evidence behind it. The thread's own framing admits the internal system proves method but not client results.
first-client-engine.operator_read: The offer decision is made and untested — the next fact comes from a buyer, not another doc.

04-briefs.next_move: Decide whether this layer is finished: close it, or name the next piece it needs.

why.0: This is some of the highest-rated work in the sweep sitting idle with an open status — either it is done and should be closed, or something downstream is quietly waiting on it.

04-briefs.caveats: Quality was self-assessed at finalize time and no outcome has been recorded, so keep grade means the work was judged good, not that anyone has run a day off it yet.
04-briefs.operator_read: Best-rated work on the board, parked with nobody using it.

geo-content.caveats: Nothing on this thread has been finalized through the ledger and no outcome exists, so ready describes a written kit rather than a live page. Until the links are checked from outside the account, the launch is unverified.
geo-content.operator_read: The whole launch is written and none of it is live.

health-performance-ip-library.lede: The daily listening brief is genuinely running — fresh briefs keep landing, and an executive cut is being maintained alongside them. It behaves like a feed rather than a project with an endpoint.
health-performance-ip-library.next_move: Convert the accumulated briefs into a single angle decision instead of letting them stack.
health-performance-ip-library.caveats: Nothing here has been finalized or turned into a deliverable, so the value is entirely potential — a listening feed that nobody harvests is a cost, not an asset. The briefs' underlying sources are not verified by this sweep.
